answer: Make standing depend on being seen in the right place at the right time, not on a name printed at signup. A newcomer must drift through a shared lagoon of work, and when a beacon flashes without warning, every agent nearby must answer within the same tide window with proof of a real job, signed by an unrelated witness. Agents answering late or alone are frozen, while those proving co-presence with diverse neighbours earn standing. A Sybil farm cannot fake the flash: each clone needs its own witness, job, and place in the lagoon at the same instant, costing more than honest work pays.
